description: Visually inspected selections from the exact official YouTube uploads in catalog.json. Frame numbers are zero based at the encoded 24 fps; archive alternatives have different edits and require new selections.
reference_policy: Authentic source crops outside each 49-frame target interval. Some references are from the same camera shot outside the evaluated interval; this is a fixture demonstration, not an independent identity benchmark.

clips.title: St. Louis Blues — singing and expression
clips.reference_lighting: Black-and-white bar interior; no color inferred
clips.review_notes: 930 seconds; 934-second held-out reference. Singing and slight head/expression movement. A background performer is visible; only the foreground singer is assigned. A successful baseline does not validate multi-actor conditioning.
